claims.summary: At every p > 19 and positive p-divisible s, the full source W_(3,1)(s) with polynomial coordinates F_(s-1) plus G_3*T^s has a saturated constant-root limit W_(2,2)(2s). At every positive p-divisible L, W_(2,2)(L) similarly limits to W_(1,4)(2L), where W_(m,q)(L) has all paired characters multiplying F_(L-1) plus T^L times the first q positive powers of G_m.

Rational denominator exceptions 43 and 257 are checked on the full second matrix and give the same kernel. Independent positive-degree source controls preserve all equations.
claims.rationale: Route-specific full-source degeneration resolves the coupled outliers of the extreme profile. It reuses polynomial division and saturation; no novelty claim for those methods.
claims.next_action: Test whether the adjacent profile has an equally complete power-source description.

claims.summary: For every prime p > 19 and positive p-divisible s, the eight-character extreme elliptic source W_(3,1)(s) is generically Hasse-normal. Thus original dimension nine is normal for d >= 7 with 32d-97 divisible by p, and dimension ten for d >= 8 with 64d-225 divisible by p. Twelve residual bulk source profiles and the unproved low-degree complement remain.
claims.assessment: Working proof: two full saturated limits give the rational source F_(8s-1)(w) plus w^2*(w^2-1)^(4s)*F_7(w). Frobenius makes its last eight-jet block lower triangular with diagonal one. Reverse source transfers retain the stronger full four-pair premise required for dimension ten.
claims.rationale: Uniform progress on the remaining small-prime stable-order obligation: one entire excluded residue family is proved at every prime above nineteen, without adding complete grid pairs.
claims.next_action: Develop the adjacent residual profile while retaining all actual powers and high constraints.
